bio: Enjoy everyday luxury and escape to Victors Newcastle, in the heart of the city along the Quayside. Experience the modern Asian inspired menu and show stopping cocktails served under the iconic wisteria trees.  Introducing Afternoon Tea #TheVictorsWay. Indulge in a delightful selection of homemade luxury treats, from classic sandwiches including Avocado Hummus & Feta Brioche roll to an array of sweet desserts including Key Lime Pie and Strawberry Cheesecake. Served at your table with sparklers and dry ice, Afternoon Tea at Victors is like no other.
